verdict.rationale: Kong documents a Konnect API for managing AI Gateway resources (e.g., list-ai-gateways endpoint) and a dedicated kongctl CLI, showing programmatic control exists and is documented. However, probes for a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at standard locations all returned 404, so the breadth/openness of the API surface is not independently confirmed. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, broader endpoint coverage beyond the single example, and independent/hands-on confirmation of API usage.
